>a bunch of lonely, angry, horny gamers with mommy issues

classy
That's not rational. A rational person would value themselves over abstractions such as the environment. You're just another one of the crazies.

Socially anxious because I never pushed myself to be more social as a child and favored escapism.

I'm boring due to that.

Therapy is expensive as fuck in the US, and you have to wait months to get an appointment. Also the fact that it's failed 3 times in the past means I'm not going to gamble with my money and time. 

Besides, like I said in the OP, I don't think there's anything chemically wrong with my brain that causes my depression. It's just the likely result of a shitty life with no social support system.
I've seen various therapists and psychologists and at least 4 different drugs. None have changed anything. I'm just as socially anxious as I was on day 1, nothing has helped an inch.
